patch_description: Starts from the staggered hex-row layout but adds a physics-style refinement: circles are treated as soft bodies that push apart when overlapping and get pushed away from walls, with radii grown greedily each iteration (each circle takes the maximum radius allowed by its current neighborhood). This relaxation lets the staggered lattice break symmetry near the walls and fill voids, dramatically increasing the sum of radii versus the fixed constructor. A final conservative radius assignment guarantees validity.
